statement: Transform matrix service: translation moves z to 5..9 without changing the 400 volume; a 90 degree turn keeps the symmetric bounds and the volume; a 2x scale cubes the volume to 3200. The L3 declares requires_manual_test=false, so its acceptance is the automated test a_transform_moves_the_box_and_keeps_its_volume.
note: no human test is required for this L3; the record is the documented AUTO_ONLY path, not a human signature
